# Prospero

> *Our revels now are ended...*

LinkedIn outreach with a human in the loop. AI browser agents collect leads, an
LLM drafts personalized messages, you approve them in Notion, and Prospero
sends connection requests with human-paced delays. Notion is the dashboard,
data store, and approval gate.

> ## ⚠ Terms-of-Service warning — read first
>
> **LinkedIn's Terms of Service prohibit automated outreach.** Running this
> tool against your account may result in restrictions or permanent
> suspension. Account safety is your responsibility, not Prospero's.
>
> **Practical guidance from real use:**
>
> - **A brand-new "burner" account doesn't actually work well.** LinkedIn
> anonymizes out-of-network profiles ("LinkedIn Member") for cold accounts,
> so search results return mostly unusable rows. The agent has nothing to
> personalize against and the account has no inviting credibility.
